title: iOS app static + Frida assessment
steps: Unzip the IPA; `plutil -p Info.plist`, `codesign -d --entitlements`, `otool -l` for linked libs and encryption (`cryptid`).
Dump classes with `class-dump`/`jtool2`; search strings for URLs, keys, `flag`, and `NSUserDefaults`/keychain usage.
Run `frida-ps -U` and `objection -g <bundle> explore`; hook `NSUserDefaults`, keychain, and the success check.
Bypass jailbreak/pinning only in the challenge app with Frida scripts; confirm the hook fires before trusting the result.
falsifier: The binary is FairPlay-encrypted, no runtime access is available, and static strings show no local secret.
